notes.title: What happened to development?
notes.content:
[h1]Ahoy lads![/h1]
Whether you know me from The Caribbean Sail, Captain Blacksword, or just liked the character designs;  this post is long overdue. Five years overdue.

[h3]Not canceled, not actively in development.[/h3]
As the man at the helm of Victorian Clambake, there is no development news as there has been no active development on this game in years as you can see here: https://twitter.com/Jolly_Riot


I still want to make this game, I still have a vision for it, I still think it will be an absolute banger someday. So why isn't it moving?

[h3]What happened?[/h3]
I was creating this game on an even keel with the cartographer (Graphic designer, artist, and co-conspirator) and one day, I outlined how much work would be required to finish the game in the art style he had created.

It would look great, but, it would probably take more than a lifetime to make without funding and a team increase. I wasn't ready for that. He wasn't ready for that. Victorian Clambake was not ready for that.

So we made a trade. An unspoken idea we were also working on took his attention while Jolly Riot held my heart, so we made a trade. He's got that one and Jolly Riot entirely belongs to me now.

[h3]What happens next?[/h3]
I'm a one man crew at the moment so I'm going to finish Captain Blacksword. After that, I have a few choices: Work on another game idea I've had, take a second look at Shell Shuffle, or come back to Jolly Riot.

If Jolly Riot is to be completed, I'll either need to raise a fortune on Kickstarter and source a team of artists capable of a hand drawn art style- or, the game will be scaled back and I'll make it a minimally pixelated game.

Both would be a major turning point for the game but I'd still like to take a crack at bringing my vision for this game to life someday.

[h3]Check out my other works in the meantime![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2153250/Captain_Blacksword/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/657690/The_Caribbean_Sail/

[h3]Fair winds to you all![/h3]
